source.citation: Classified advertisement, 'To rent—nicely furnished rooms; good location; moderate prices. 2101 Indiana-av.'. Chicago Daily Tribune, 5 June 1905 (vol. 64 no. 133).
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, storeys, material or outline
what_it_supplies: that 2101 Indiana Avenue was a lodging house in 1905
